claims.claim: Very clean UK-Used PS4 Pro Console with 10 games and two pads
claims.evidence: Witness report shows PS4 console boxes with DualShock 4 controller graphics and a Sony logo, but does not show the console model as 'Pro', does not show the number of games, and does not show two physical pads included.

claims.claim: Neatly used, never opened or repaired, no overheating
claims.evidence: Witness report does not include internal/opened status or overheating indicators; only external box/stacked unit appearance is described.
No testing/port demonstration is shown in the witness observations.

claims.claim: Comes with the original pads and the UK receipt
claims.evidence: Witness report notes controller graphics on the boxes but does not show physical controllers or a UK receipt.

risks.risk: Console may not be PS4 Pro (could be a different PS4 model/version), which affects value.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the console label showing the exact CUH model number and storage capacity (HDD/SSD size).
risks.if_unproven: Price as a standard PS4 (worst-case within PS4 family) with unknown storage.

risks.risk: Games may not be included, or the count may be less than claimed.
risks.proof: A photo/video showing all game discs/cases laid out with titles visible (or a screenshot list if digital).

risks.risk: Controllers may be missing or may have issues (stick drift, unresponsive buttons).
risks.proof: Close-up photos of both controllers plus a short clip showing button presses and analog stick movement (including a drift check).
risks.if_unproven: Price as console with no guaranteed working controllers.

risks.risk: Console may be non-functional or have faults (disc drive, Wi‑Fi/Bluetooth, overheating, corrupted system).
risks.proof: A short test clip: console boots to home screen, Wi‑Fi connects, and disc drive reads a disc (or shows a game running).
risks.if_unproven: Price as 'not tested / not guaranteed working'.

risks.risk: Accessories/cables may be incomplete or non-original (power/HDMI/USB/headset/manuals).
risks.proof: A photo of everything included laid out, showing each cable/headset and any branding/labels.

risks.risk: Account status may be problematic (not signed out, prior bans, or setup issues).
risks.proof: A clip showing the console setup screen or account sign-out status (no active locked account).
risks.if_unproven: Price assuming account/setup may require extra work.

proof_requests: Send a clear photo of the console’s label (CUH model number) and storage capacity (HDD/SSD size).
Show all included games laid out with titles visible (or a video walkthrough of the full set).
Show both physical DualShock 4 controllers (front/back) and provide a short test clip for buttons and analog sticks.
Provide a boot-to-home-screen test clip, plus Wi‑Fi/Bluetooth connection confirmation and a disc-drive read test (if discs are included).
List and photograph every accessory included (power cable, HDMI, USB, headset, manuals) to confirm originals and completeness.
Show the console account status (signed out / no locked account) via a short clip.
response.reason: The witness confirms PS4/PS4-box visuals but cannot verify the key value drivers (Pro model, working status, included games, and whether two working pads are physically included). Without those proof points, any price would be too uncertain.
